hook.name: Pangea Fee Hook
hook.description: PangeaFeeHook charges a fixed fee (0.3%–5%, set once per pool at registration) in the pool's configured quote currency on every swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, collecting fees as ERC-6909 claims redeemable to a per-pool splitter. It restricts liquidity additions to a designated seeder, enforces that swaps cannot push the price past the launch range's empty edge, and waives fees for a designated dev buyer address.
